resolution: Fixed 'the cooked prop shows in the palette but won't place.' Root cause was a sync-ordering bug, not logic: game/world/stream.ts:267 drops a piecePlaced whose pieceId isn't a known catalog id, and a V20 stream's state() is a cached fold (snapshot + incremental appends), so when the worldStream folded buildPieces BEFORE the cooked-prop overlay was synced (it was synced lazily by the deep CatalogRail, which renders after the fold), the placed cooked prop was dropped and stayed gone. Verified with a new headless repro (editors/model/cookedPlacement.test.ts, 4/4) that walks the exact chain — overlay resolves, catalog lists, validatePlacement passes, and the worldStream materializer KEEPS the cooked piecePlaced — proving the logic is correct given sync order. Fix: added ensureCookedRegistry() to editors/model/cookedAssets.ts (registers the persisted cooked props into the prop + build-catalog overlays) and call it in index.tsx in a useMemo BEFORE editorChannel(worldStream) is created, so the overlay is populated ahead of every fold and the placement apply. This makes a cooked prop placeable now AND survive a cold reload. cookedPlacement 4/4, cookedAsset 13, cookedAssetStream 8, build 25 all green; index.tsx + IsoAuthor bundle clean; hot-reloadable. The /compiled bake + texture fold remain. Uncommitted by the user's lead.
